CustomField.description: AJ: Created for NZC Implementation, This field is created to indicate whether the Haul Type is Domestic or not for UK Airport.
CustomField.formula: IF(UK_Airport__c == TRUE, IF(International__c == TRUE, IF( (SegmentDistance < 3700 && ISPICKVAL(SegmentDistanceUnit , 'Kilometers')) || (SegmentDistance < 2299.07341 && ISPICKVAL(SegmentDistanceUnit , 'Miles')), 'Short', 'Long') , $Label.NZC_UK_Domestic_Haul), IF((SegmentDistance < 3700 && ISPICKVAL(SegmentDistanceUnit , 'Kilometers')) || (SegmentDistance < 2299.07341 && ISPICKVAL(SegmentDistanceUnit , 'Miles')), 'Short', 'Long'))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: If the Flight is UK then Haul Type will be measured as Domestic Haul.
CustomField.label: Haul Type
